source_metadata.exact_title: TRUSS: Towards Task-Reliable and User-Safe Automated Agent Skill Generation

extraction_scope.included: Primary arXiv v1 manuscript text, methods, main figures/tables, benchmark results, conclusion, and source-stated limitations.
extraction_scope.excluded: Reference-list entries were not atomized. No separate supplement or appendix was available in the accessed manuscript.
extraction_scope.assertion_origin_policy: Paraphrased source claims and reported numeric results are normalized_from_source. No appraisal statement was encoded as reported evidence.

extraction_limitations: The atom set is based on the accessible 14-page arXiv v1 manuscript.
The accessible main paper says component ablation is reported separately, but no component ablation appears in the 14-page manuscript; no component-level causal attribution was inferred.
The paper evaluates controlled benchmarks and scenario/property observers. The atom set does not convert benchmark performance into a claim of general or production safety.
All atoms remain needs_review rather than verified because this extraction has not received independent human review.
